Scope: All authorised institutions and group functions
Allowed actions: Group configuration; cross-institute dashboards; privileged approvals; audit/KPI views
Prohibited by default: None without audit/approval; all actions logged
Boundary: Highest business role but still audited

Scope: All institutions in authorised finance/HR domains
Allowed actions: Group finance; authorised fee/ledger updates; payroll/HR finance updates; consolidated reports
Prohibited by default: Unrelated student wellbeing/discipline data unless separately granted

Allowed actions: Collect payments; receipts; operational fee follow-up; paid/pending/overdue reconciliation; reminders; daily reports
Read-only visibility: Minimum fee demand/payment status needed for collection
Prohibited by default: Global payroll; other institutes; fee-master edits; concessions/refunds/write-offs; ledger adjustments; bank/gateway settlement unless explicitly assigned
Boundary: Collection reconciliation is not bank settlement reconciliation

Allowed actions: Manage academics/staff; approve school workflows; designated local operational/fee changes; local departments/tasks
Read-only visibility: Institute dashboards and permitted finance summaries

Scope: Explicitly assigned grades/classes/sections in own institution
Allowed actions: Attendance and academic coordination; view assigned students; review academic workflows; support fee follow-up
Read-only visibility: Minimum pending-fee status for assigned classes
Prohibited by default: Unassigned classes; payment posting; ledger mutation; global reports
Boundary: Example grades 2–5 means all sections of grades 2–5 only

Allowed actions: Attendance; homework; diary; marks entry; own timetable; assigned student learning data
Read-only visibility: Minimum fee status for own class only if enabled
Prohibited by default: Unassigned students/classes; fee posting; sensitive financial details; role admin

Allowed actions: View child profile/attendance/homework/diary/results/fees; acknowledge/respond; pay selected items for one or more children
Read-only visibility: Only linked children and permitted history
Prohibited by default: Other families; internal transaction audit; staff-only notes; unverified sibling
Other student records; parent-only payment/relationship controls

Allowed actions: Register visitor; record purpose/host; issue/close pass; view active visits
Read-only visibility: Minimum directory data needed to identify host
Prohibited by default: Student academic/fee data; payroll; other campuses
Boundary: Visitor personal data retention/access policy required

Scope: Assigned institution(s) or explicitly granted group scope
Allowed actions: Staff lifecycle; shifts; leave approvals; attendance exceptions; payroll preparation
Read-only visibility: Assigned employees and approved HR reports
Prohibited by default: Student financial records; employees outside grant; unapproved salary changes

Allowed actions: Room/bed allocation; hosteller attendance; incidents; mess/hostel operations
Read-only visibility: Assigned hostellers and balances needed for operations
Prohibited by default: Other institutions; unrelated academic/finance data; ledger adjustments

Allowed actions: Question bank; paper blueprints; tests; evaluation; batch analytics
Prohibited by default: Unrelated school/college records; restricted cross-batch data
Boundary: Coaching exam product distinct from school exams

Allowed actions: Semester/course operations; evaluation; moderation; applicable OBE evidence
Manage system settings/integrations/accounts as authorised; support diagnostics
Prohibited by default: Unlogged business transaction edits; production data extraction without approval
Boundary: Technical access is not business approval
